description: Machine-readable parameter inventory of the Pianoid engine (the parameter glossary): every parameter domain and field with units, range, key space, stored vs derived/effective, the registry command that reads / writes it and its doc anchor. Served to the in-UI assistant by param.inventory. Every value is taken from the docs; anchors are relative to docs/ (MkDocs slugs).
unknown_policy: UNKNOWN = the docs do not state it; measure before relying on it

doc_conflicts.what: Hammer width floor: Basic OVERVIEW says the width is clamped to a minimum of 3*dx; REST_API says the rendered width is hammer_width_effective = max(stored, 1.05*dx).

CFL handling of a string edit: REST_API (v2) says an edit that would diverge is REJECTED with 400 CflRejected and never applied; PARAMETER_SYSTEM says the granular gate SKIPS the upload (edit stays in the Python model, no 4xx, accept threshold CFL_MARGIN = 0.8 on the Courant number); SYNTHESIS_ENGINE (v3, 2026-07-08) says the gate is REMOVED, CFL is an indicator only and every edit is applied.

gauss_flat length: REST_API says a flat array of 100 values (5 levels x 20); Basic OVERVIEW says 6 base velocity levels (LEVEL_INDICES 0,5,31,63,95,127) with 20 reals per level, legacy 5-level presets migrated on load.

Output-pitch feedin: Basic OVERVIEW 'Coupling Coefficients' says feedback equals feedin for both regular AND output pitches; the 'Output Pitches' table (and SYNTHESIS_ENGINE) say output pitches have feedin = 0 and feedback = the mode shape at the receiver.

Effectiveness of stored feedback rows: /health single_deck_matrix says the active build has ONE packed matrix (feedin only), feedback = feedin x deck_feedback_coeff, and the per-pitch feedback matrix editor is meaningless; the Sound-channel editing section measures that feedback/<128+ch> row edits change the render. Which feedback rows (piano vs output pitches) are kernel-effective is not stated in one place.

Runtime parameters and the volume formula: PARAMETER_SYSTEM lists RuntimeParameters as {volume_level, deck_feedback_coefficient} with only the legacy max_volume^(level/127) formula; REST_API documents volume_center / volume_range (the default sensitivity formula center*range^((level-64)/63)), amplitude_limit and amplitude_gate_enabled.

String 'tail': the Data Model Card says the GET field tail is DERIVED (= length/10); PARAMETER_SYSTEM slot 1 and Basic StringGeometry call tail a spatial point count. The unit of the GET value is therefore unstated.

Mode state layout: SYNTHESIS_ENGINE 'Discrete update' says dev_mode_state holds only the 3xN config (dec, omega, mass_inv) with q / q_prev in dev_mode_running; 'Mode Excitation' still describes dev_mode_state as the 5N [q, q_prev, dec, omega, mass_inv] layout.

Defaults differ by layer: string_iteration defaults to 12 in Basic ModelParameters, 4 in the documented /load_preset body, 6 in GET /get_settings; listen_to_modes defaults to False in Basic ModelParameters but 1 in /load_preset.

envelope.description: The A2 envelope of the assistant's Auto writes (categories params / runtime, v2 proposal section 9): a field or domain carries an `envelope` entry only where the docs give a limit; everything else is Ask-only (the policy asks even when the category is Auto).
not_in_envelope: string (needs a prospective CFL check, not available)
hammer / gauss / excitation (no documented step limit)
feedin / feedback / sound_channel raw rows (no documented step limit)
